d:
The Magic defeated the Jazz, 123-106 tonight in Utah. Franz Wagner finished with a team-high 38 points along with 8 rebounds and 3 three pointers for the Magic, while Desmond Bane tallied 25 points, 7 three pointers and 3 rebounds in the game. Darryn Peterson recorded 20 points, 5 assists and 4 rebounds. The Magic improve their record to 4-7 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 1-11 for the season.
